messages:
jasper: Heads-up: planning to roll engine variant `engine:v2.3.0-quant-compact` into the night bucket at 23:00 PST. This swaps matmul kernel and changes a quant path. Preflight looked ok but we saw some sticky session requeues on staging. Anyone see anything else?
anya: saw ~2–3% p99 increase on staging for certain sequence lengths (512->1024) during the matmul flip. Batch=8. Noticed a few KV cache misses spike. :thinking_face:
liam: we had one evict loop in the perf logs last night but it self-healed. I can pull logs if needed.
rachel: also saw a tiny uptick in GPU SM utilization on canary - about +6% for ~5m, likely the kernel path. No errors.
sre-oncall: pinging @deploybot for the scheduled rollout window and safety gates. Also suggest TTL pin option if we need to rollback fast.
deploybot: DeployBot: initiating staged rollout for `engine:v2.3.0-quant-compact` · window=23:00-03:00 PST · strategy=regional-stagger(10%) · canary=us-west1 · health-check=latency,p95_errors
jasper: decision point: proceed with staggered regional rollout but add an automatic pin/rollback trigger if p99 > baseline + 3s or error rate > 0.5% over 5m. Also we should exclude high-throughput customers by pinning them to `engine:v2.2.9` for the window.
anya: agree on triggers. Suggest adding a short pre-roll sweep to warm KV cache and run a small sample of heavy prompts (seq=1024, batch=8). That reduced the tail in my repro.
liam: here's a quick pin command I tested in staging:
```
/deploy pin engine:v2.2.9 --selector=customer_tier:enterprise --ttl=6h --reason="night fallback for quant-kernel swap"
```
liam: if we need to unpin quickly: `/deploy unpin --selector=customer_tier:enterprise`
rachel: can someone add a line to the release notes for the ops page: "Engine v2.3.0: matmul kernel swap, quant-compact path. Watch p99, fallback pin available." I'll push the notes once approved.
sre-oncall: add an observability watchbook entry too: which metrics to monitor (p50/p95/p99 latency, errors, eviction rate, GPU SM). Include escalation: page at 3m sustained > trigger.
deploybot: DeployBot: pre-roll task completed: warmed 200 hosts in canary subset, KV priming done. checksum OK.
jasper: OK plan: go ahead with staged rollout at 23:00. Pre-roll success is good. Action items: 1) @rachel update release notes, 2) @liam stage pin command ready, 3) @anya run heavy prompt sweep at T-15, 4) @sre-oncall set pager rules. If any of the triggers fire, immediate region pin -> rollback to v2.2.9 and open postmortem.
anya: noted. I'll run sweep at 22:45 and report results here. :white_check_mark:
liam: I'll prep pin/unpin snippets and hold until ops gives the go.
rachel: writing release note now, will post draft by 22:30.
deploybot: DeployBot: rollout started at 23:00 PST · region=us-west1 · step=10%
jasper: monitoring live metrics dashboard. Will call for rollback if p99 breach sustained >5m.
anya: first canary 10% looks fine at 23:10 — p99 within baseline+200ms. continuing to watch.
liam: thumbs up from infra: no driver errors surfaced so far.
rachel: release notes published: https://internal/docs/releases/engine-2.3.0 — added ops lines and rollback playbook.
sre-oncall: queued pager policy updated. If we hit the rollback condition, I'll kick the pin and coordinate region drain.
jasper: good run. keeping the rest of rollout staggered. Post-roll retro tomorrow to capture what warming pattern worked. Thanks all. :tada:
